## 4 Operations on THH of O -algebras

The goal of this section is to initiate the study of endomorphisms of THH viewed as a functor Alg O (Cat perf ) → Sp, that is, to study the extra operations that arise on THH( C ) when C has a particular kind of multiplicative structure encoded by a one-colored ∞ -operad O . Our main result in this section is Theorem B.

We first describe the general approach to this question, and then specialize to get the precise results that we claimed.

As is clear from the statement of Theorem B, the case of endomorphisms of THH viewed as a functor on Alg O (Cat perf ) is more subtle.
